parsed.main_gap: Lemma 1 invokes a false unbounded infinite-sunflower claim, though the bounded-size version actually needed is valid and repairs the proof.

errors.description: The stated sunflower fact is false for finite sets of unbounded size: for example, X_n={1,…,n} has no infinite sunflower subfamily. The argument only needs sets of bounded size, for which the infinite sunflower lemma is valid; restating and proving that version repairs the gap.

parsed.notes: Apart from the overstrong false lemma, the support self-duality, weight descent, finiteness reduction, and final periodicity argument are coherent. Applying the same sunflower argument specifically to minimal transversals of size at most K yields the required finiteness.
